correctness.rationale: The 24 incidence vertices and explicit acyclic rooted-forest criterion specify every face. Exhaustive independent enumerations produce 12,800 distinct faces and match the rooted-forest Laplacian polynomial. An explicitly defined greedy matching has 6,181 pairs; full 12,799-vertex directed-Hasse topological sort proves acyclicity, leaving critical cells in dimensions 0,4,5 with counts 1,2,434. Exact gradient-path computation of all 434 attaching degrees gives a 2x434 integral boundary with a displayed determinant ±1 minor and entries ±1 or 0, hence a wedge of 432 five-spheres. A separate mod-two top rank check gives 3024−2592=432. Exact signed fixed-face traces for all 144 S3xS4 elements, with reduced Lefschetz correction, give every character entry and the integral nonnegative Specht multiplicities. Code was run successfully from actual included standalone files; there is no extrapolation.

Unindexed equivalent work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The finite complete bipartite graph K_{3,4} is the first naturally asymmetric bipartite extension after the separately classified K_{3,3} and K_{2,n} cases. The published primary paper explicitly identifies the complete-bipartite homotopy classification as unresolved. A 432-sphere integral homotopy classification and a complete nontrivial S3xS4 homology character across 15 conjugacy classes are precise natural invariants of this symmetry-rich complex, distinguish equivariant behavior beyond Betti number 432, and provide a reproducible benchmark for structural methods. This is not just an Euler-characteristic or scalar table recomputation; exact attaching maps and the full representation are determined.
